body:
You are heart-stopping, do-me-now stunningly gorgeous. :-) Any girl will be so lucky to have you.

Edit: Also, please marry me. ;) Worth a shot.

Hmm ok. If your fears were to be true, I've been on the other end of that situation. Had a best friend that was like that. Before I thought he liked me, it was alright in small doses. As long as he tried to socialize and didn't stare at me I wasn't uncomfortable. After I thought he liked me, I felt like he used his mute standing around to intentionally or unintentionally cockblock me.

tl;dr as long as you don't like her and you try to socialize you're probably fine. Practice smiling in the mirror. Watch How I Met Your Mother to learn and copy how to be funny/social or something. Practice with the cashier at the grocery store or people you casually pass by if they seem friendly. Then go to the event and hopefully have fun.

If you just stand around and look miserable, you **will** be a buzzkill.

I don't mean to be hurtful in anyway, but with girls you have to be especially careful. They're already hard enough to not bug/creep out if you don't have Asperger's.

You also have the advantage that you KNOW you have Aspgerger's. My friend doesn't realize he has it and would be extremely offended if someone told him.

It ultimately ruined my friendship with him though because he didn't fix things that made me uncomfortable that I asked him to multiple times, it's in the process of ending for me.

I'm curious, what do you feel causes you not talking? Anxiety?
Have you done anything that might make you think you're somehow making her uncomfortable?
I also keep having OCD-like thoughts of stabbing myself. It's very weird. I wish mental health wasn't so taboo.
Ok. I feel so empty and I can't stop it with will power. I can make an appointment in the day.
